description: Change an Insights report: its title, description or settings, and its widgets. Edit single widgets by id without resending the rest: `addWidgets` appends new widgets, `replaceWidgets` swaps each named widget in place, `removeWidgetIds` deletes widgets. Or send `widgets` to replace the whole list in render order (a widget left out is deleted); `widgets` cannot be combined with the single-widget edits. Every widget is validated as the Console validates it: an invalid query is refused with 400 `invalid_widget_query` (the widget id and the validator's code in `detail`) and nothing is saved. Preview each new query with anyforge_preview_report_query first. If the report changed since you read it, a single-widget edit is refused with 409 `report_modified`: read it again. If the report has a live share link, the people holding it see the change. Requires `write` scope and a role that edits reports. Only call when the person asked for this change. Each report carries `url`, its Console page; when you show a report to the user, render its title as a link to that url.

addWidgets.description: New widgets, appended in this order. Each id must be new.

items.description: A widget: { id, type, title, width, query, description?, viewFilters? }. `id` is a short slug unique in the report; `width` is fifth|quarter|third|half|full; `type` and `query` (a ReportQuery: { source, measure, groupBy?, timeRangeDays?, dateField?, filters?, limit?, … }) must match the data catalog (anyforge_describe_report_catalog).

replaceWidgets.description: Changed widgets; each replaces the stored widget with the same id, in place.

trendDays.description: How far back stat and kpi trends compare, in days (default 7; 0 turns trends off). A value the Console does not offer is refused with 400 `invalid_trend_days`.

widgets.description: The whole widget list, in render order. Replaces every widget.
